notes: Each eval runs in its own empty workspace (the agent is told to cd there). Checks read: the CLI invocation log (filtered by cwd = workspace), files the CLI wrote (spec.json, analysis.json, report.pdf), the agent's final reply, and the agent transcript. 'artifact' checks only make sense with the skill; 'reply' checks apply to both with-skill and baseline runs. Grader: evals/grade.py. caveats_relayed / confidence_label_exact read the verdict the agent saw from the invocation log (last analyze/report call of the graded turn: confidence per language, caveat codes, must_relay codes).
